data.desc: Contango is a NYSE American and TSX-listed mining company engaged in the exploration for and development of silver, gold and associated minerals in Alaska and British Columbia's Golden Triangle. Its Canadian assets comprise approximately 247,000 acres of mineral tenures in and around Kitsault Valley. In Alaska, Contango holds a 30% interest in the Peak Gold JV at Manh Choh, operated by an indirect subsidiary of Kinross Gold Corporation. Contango also holds 100% ownership of Lucky Shot, comprising mineral rights to approximately 8,600 acres near Willow, Alaska; a lease on Johnson Tract covering approximately 21,000 acres from CIRI; mineral rights to approximately 145,000 acres of State of Alaska mining claims; and rights to approximately 15,260 acres of State mining claims and upland mining leases.
